source: Windows System.Speech.Synthesis; installed Microsoft Zira Desktop voice; synthesized locally without network audio or speaker playback.
note: Isolated word pronunciation is generated by the voice engine; pronunciation of some homographs depends on context. Examples are original learning content.
postProcessing: Leading/trailing silence trimmed only; 100 ms padding retained; PCM speech samples otherwise unchanged.
encoder: Windows MediaTranscoder / built-in Windows MP3 encoder, locally encoded without downloading third-party audio.

vocabularyCorrections.reason: Remove two noisy entries and the malformed duplicate uptodate. The standard entry up-to-date already exists in the source vocabulary.
